description: This file contains utility functions and classes for parsing and formatting HTTP headers, including URI parsing, character and control character checks, and whitespace handling, as part of a WebSocket implementation.

classes.name: ParsingState
classes.description: Represents the state during parsing, holding the data string and current position index.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the character at a given position from the current head without advancing the position.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Consumes a specified number of characters from the current position and advances the head.

methods.name: consume_string
methods.description: Consumes a specific string from the current position if it matches exactly.

methods.name: consume_lws
methods.description: Consumes linear whitespace (LWS) including optional CRLF and spaces or tabs.

methods.name: consume_lwses
methods.description: Consumes multiple LWS sequences from the current position.

methods.name: consume_token
methods.description: Consumes an HTTP token from the current position.

methods.name: consume_token_or_quoted_string
methods.description: Consumes either a token or a quoted string, returning the unquoted string.

methods.name: quote_if_necessary
methods.description: Quotes a string if it contains characters that require quoting according to HTTP rules.

methods.name: parse_uri
methods.description: Parses a URI and returns hostname, port, and resource path.
